description: This file defines the HashTable class used within the PhpSpreadsheet library, implementing a hash table data structure with methods for adding, removing, retrieving, and cloning items, specifically handling objects implementing IComparable.

classes.name: HashTable
classes.description: A hash table implementation for storing IComparable objects, with methods for managing items and cloning the structure.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HashTable, optionally from a source array.

methods.name: addFromSource
methods.description: Adds multiple items from a source array into the hash table.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a single IComparable item to the hash table.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an IComparable item from the hash table.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the hash table.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the hash table.

methods.name: getIndexForHashCode
methods.description: Retrieves the index of a hash code within the key map.

methods.name: getByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves an item by its index.

methods.name: getByHashCode
methods.description: Retrieves an item by its hash code.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the hash table items as an array.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the hash table object.
